item.tib: gsas mkhar zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus las gta' chen phud kyi rim pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis/ lho rgyal mo tsha ba rong ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter la drangs zhing / mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o//
